description: This Java source file defines a package-private class 'JsonObjectMerger' that implements a recursive JSON object merging function, prioritizing the first object in conflicts. It includes methods for merging JSON objects, arrays, and values, utilizing the Eclipse Ditto JSON library.

classes.name: JsonObjectMerger
classes.description: A final class implementing BiFunction to merge two JsonObject instances recursively, with conflict resolution favoring the first object.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Overrides BiFunction.apply() to merge two JsonObjects using the private mergeJsonObjects method.

methods.name: mergeJsonObjects
methods.description: Recursively merges two JsonObjects, combining fields and handling nested objects and arrays.

methods.name: mergeJsonValues
methods.description: Merges two JsonValues, handling cases where values are objects, arrays, or other types.

methods.name: areJsonObjects
methods.description: Checks if two JsonValues are both JSON objects.

methods.name: areJsonArrays
methods.description: Checks if two JsonValues are both JSON arrays.

methods.name: mergeJsonArrays
methods.description: Merges two JsonArrays element-wise, combining values and appending remaining elements from the longer array.

methods.name: getOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves an element from a JsonArray at a specified index or throws an exception if absent.
